0040fc40.widths: Framebuffer pointer e92e18, pitch e38d94, X d3b5e0, Y d3b5dc, row count d3b5d4 and row gap d3b53c are fullDWORD. Width d3b5be is a signedWORD. Commands and skip lengths are unsignedBYTE; pixels are WORD.
0040fc40.behavior: Call actual410f20 first even when the draw height is nonpositive. Capture doubled signed width after that helper. Compute the wrapped byte address frame+pitch*y+2*x. For each positive-height row, reload signed width and add captured2*width to the current cursor. Copy literal WORDs leftward, skip transparent runs leftward, and advance from the actual final cursor by rowgap+captured2*width.
0040fc40.leftward_origin: For an exactly filled positive-width row, the first pixel is written at x+width and the last at x+1. The implementation preserves this original inclusive/right-edge convention.
0040fc40.literal_cutoff: When remaining width becomes0 inside a literal, stop immediately without consuming the rest of that literal payload. The following row starts at that actual consumed source position, even when it lies inside the earlier literal's nominal payload.
0040fc40.transparent_overshoot: A transparent run may make remaining width negative. Its complete byte skip is applied before ending the row; no fabricated clamp is added.
0040fc40.zero_width: Zero or negative signed width consumes no source within the drawing loop. Positive row counts still execute the original row-cursor arithmetic; nonpositive height still performs the row-skip helper call.
0040fc40.stack_scratch: Native40fc9c writes the skip BYTE into its own by-value input argument slot, then masks a DWORD load to8bits. This is internal scratch. Stack canaries are checked outside the argument slot; the public C interface remains void.
0040fc40.native_EAX: EAX retains the final consumed source pointer. A test-only finish trace compares this full pointer while preserving the void production interface. Four retained native callers use side effects and then select their own width/color result.

00410f20.behavior: Read full signedDWORD row-skip count. For each positive row, reload signedWORD width and clear the full EAX scratch value. Load tags and skip lengths into only its low byte. Subtract the full scratch from remaining width. Literal advance doubles the full scratch and adds1, retaining its high24 bits for the next byte load. Transparent advance adds2 to the pointer and likewise preserves the full scratch high bits. Return the exact final source pointer.
00410f20.quirk: The native helper is not equivalent to zero-extending every RLE tag. The high bits left by a preceding long literal can affect a subsequent literal, skip or zero tag. This behavior is preserved intentionally; no asset-domain restriction is assumed.

limitations: Fixtures use valid mapped source/frame storage. No arbitrary malformed-stream termination guarantee or entire-city pixel fidelity is claimed.
The native ABI requires a clear direction flag. Public decoder EAX is not promoted to a production return contract; its pointer is additionally observed only through compile-time test tracing.
